threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of just 'the Overground' when you need to go to Shoreditch. Classic rookie mistake.
Saw a guy on the N181 holding a pizza box while trying to balance on one leg. When the bus hit a bump, he dropped it and everyone gasped.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I caught the smell of grilled halloumi at the Saturday market and saw neighbors arguing about the best kebab place—definitely felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a cafe that serves 10 different types of vegan currywurst. It’s a quirky blend of tradition and modern veganism.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know the taco truck’s secret location changes every couple of months. Tourists just snap pics without tasting the real deal.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy in a tuxedo trying to catch the 49 while juggling a bouquet. Nailed the bus stop but dropped the flowers. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every tapas bar serves paella. It's like asking for pizza at a sushi place — they just don't do it here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they still look for the menu in Spanish before realizing it's all in Catalan here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new when you still call it the 'Overground' instead of the 'Ginger Line'. The locals have their own lingo down here.
Caught a guy on the N133 last night singing opera to a bemused group of night revellers. Must've been a forgotten star—missed my stop listening.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a lady negotiating with a pigeon over a bread roll at Tempelhofer Feld while the sun set. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous techno raves in the forest at night. Just follow the sound—nature meets the Berliner party spirit. It's surreal.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know to avoid BART on Fridays—too many overheated brakes and smoke alarms to make it worth it.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy bring his pet iguana on the 38 today, and the driver just shrugged. Only in San Francisco, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí; they miss the tiny, winding streets where neighbors still gather for xurreria at all hours.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones baffled by the schedule of the Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat, staring at the screens like they’re reading hieroglyphics.
